thread:
Amy Chen: Hey team — preparing the on-prem POC for AtlasRetail (Dell R750xd, 4x A100 40GB). Customer wants an air-gapped deploy. Need a concise preflight validation list and access plan so sales can commit to dates.
Jordan Blake: Got it. Key asks: 1) full node spec 2) network isolation method (bastion vs VPN) 3) who will manage K8s control plane (they said they have an existing k8s 1.27 cluster) 4) expected qps and latency targets for the POC.
Amy Chen: Cluster is self-managed. They want Redwood Private installed in their VPC-equivalent network (on-prem VLAN). POC will run a single dedicated pool sized for 300 concurrent sessions, mostly 1k token responses.
Rajesh Iyengar: Notes for infra preflight (short):
- NVIDIA driver: recommend 535.113.01 (tested with our runtime)
- CUDA toolkit: 12.1 runtime compatibility
- Container runtime: containerd 1.7+ or Docker 24.0+, prefer containerd for stability
- K8s: 1.26 or 1.27 supported; kube-proxy in ipvs mode recommended
- nvidia-container-toolkit installed and configured
- kernel: RHEL 8.7+/Ubuntu 22.04 with 5.15+ kernel
- nv_peer_mem / RDMA: not required for POC but note if they plan multi-node NVLink workloads
Commands we ask them to run and paste output:

```
# verify driver
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,memory.total --format=csv

# cuda check (on node)
ldconfig -p | grep cuda

# containerd
containerd --version

# kube version
kubectl version --short
```

Rajesh Iyengar: Firewall/ports: allow outbound to our control plane endpoints on 443 (TLS), and from nodes to image registry (if using our hosted registry) on 443. If fully air-gapped -> they must provide an internal registry and we provide tarballs for images.
Mia Torres: For access: customer prefers a temporary bastion with 2 admin SSH keys (will rotate after POC). They will provide a jump host with endpoint + ephemeral user. We need a service account (api key) for Redwood Private control plane to authenticate; for air-gapped we can use an offline registration token. Also need to confirm CA cert trust chain for their internal PKI.
Sam Park: Security checklist items from SOC/compliance side:
- SSO: they want SAML integration. We support SAML 2.0, need IdP metadata and an SP-initiated flow test window.
- KMS: They will use HashiCorp Vault with transit; we need KMS endpoints and allowed cipher suites.
- Audit logs: retention default 90d, can be extended. For air-gapped POC we will ship a log-forwarder container to push to their ELK/Graylog.
- Secrets: keys must be injected via k8s secrets sealed by their KMS or our sealed-secrets workflow — confirm which.
Rajesh Iyengar: Small config snippets we will validate on their side:

```
# check nvidia runtime in containerd
cat /etc/containerd/config.toml | grep -A3 nvidia

# check kubelet flags
ps aux | grep kubelet | grep "--eviction-hard"
```

Jordan Blake: Pricing/commit question from customer — they want an estimate for a 2-week POC using a 4-GPU pool and then a 3-month pilot. I proposed: POC nominal credits (we offer trial credits for dedicated pools) + per-GPU-hour rate. I'll follow up with finance for exact numbers. For now, we need to confirm the pool sizing and whether they'll allow burst to public hosted for overflow.
Amy Chen: Action items:
- Rajesh: provide a short one-page preflight doc with exact driver/CUDA/containerd lines and the commands to run (ETA EOD tomorrow).
- Mia: draft access plan (bastion user names, jump host IP, onboarding window) and confirm if they want an SSH key or cert-based auth.
- Sam: send the minimum KMS/SAML metadata template and the list of audit/log endpoints we can accept.
- Jordan: flag pricing and ask finance about POC credits & pilot discount.

deploy-bot: deployment template note: if air-gapped, use our `images-offline-v2.tar.gz` bundle and run `./install.sh --offline --registry <internal-reg>`; offline install needs 4.5GB free per node and requires kubeadm v1.27 kubeconfig.

Amy Chen: thanks — please drop confirmations here. Once we have driver/cuda checks and bastion details we can lock dates. :white_check_mark:
